title: No Rest for the Wicked (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis:
Fantasia International Film Festival
New Zealand International Film Festival

Asian Premiere

The Faroe Islands, 1862: On a windswept rock in the North Atlantic, young fisherman Baldur lives a life of grinding routine until the mysterious and rugged Helge washes ashore, awakening something deep and dangerous within him. Beneath the crushing weight of family, faith and community, their mutual attraction must be kept secret at all costs. But when tragedy strikes, their forbidden passion unleashes forces darker than either could imagine, and the villagers rally to drive out the evil they sense in their midst. Adapting Karl Heinrich Ulrichs's 1884 novella, director Kasper Kalle pours new blood into vampire lore with a haunting, subversive queer folk-horror that recalls Dreyer and Robert Eggers. Egor Venned and Pilou Asbæk smoulder against the stark Faroese landscape. Premiering at Fantasia, this is gothic romance at its most full-blooded with a love that refuses to stay buried.
cast: Egor Venned, Pilou Asbæk, Sofia Nolsøe
